summary: First test run of EduFlow Turkish LMS. Created 37 pytest backend tests covering auth, users, groups, questions, trainings, video upload/streaming with Range, assignments (future vs immediate visibility), employee learn flow (heartbeat anti-cheat clamp, checkpoint gating, wrong/right/timed_out checkpoint answers, video-complete gating), quiz (pre-complete block, grading, free_text=None correct), and reports (overview/training/assignment-detail). ALL 37 backend tests pass. Frontend smoke tested with Playwright using seeded admin (tugberkkalay@gmail.com session) and a created employee session: login page renders google-login-btn; admin sidebar navigates to all 6 pages (Dashboard, Users, Questions, Trainings, Assignments, Reports, Notifications) without errors; add-user / add-question / add-training modals expose all required data-testids and successfully create records; Notifications page shows mock activation & assignment emails; employee sees my-training-card cards, opens WatchPage with video-player + video-play-btn. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: list_users returns raw user docs without projection filter for hashed/sensitive fields - fine today but be careful when adding sensitive fields later

elapsed defaults to 3.0 when no prior heartbeat exists, letting first heartbeat jump to ~7.5s (3*1.5+3). Effectively OK because next call clamps subsequent jumps, but consider seeding last_heartbeat on progress creation to be strict.

issues: Recharts warning: chart container has width/height -1 on initial render (transient, does not crash).
Missing aria-describedby / Description on Radix DialogContent (accessibility warning, not visual).

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to admin add-user/add-question/add-training modals to silence Radix warnings.
(Optional hardening) Initialize progress.last_heartbeat when a progress doc is first created so the first heartbeat cannot claim a 3s baseline elapsed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 837 lines and mixes auth, CRUD, learn flow, streaming, and reports; consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, learn, reports) for maintainability.
list_users has no pagination (to_list(1000)); acceptable for MVP but plan for pagination.
Video streaming iterfile() uses blocking file IO inside an async endpoint — under load prefer aiofiles or offload to a thread executor.
get_progress inserts a dict then pops _id from local copy — cleaner to use projection or replace with insert + refetch.
reminder_loop sleeps 30 min; safe but has no jitter/backoff and swallows exceptions with a bare log — acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (all required data-testids present, all admin nav pages load, user creation E2E works, employee sees assignments and watch page renders video player)

test_credentials: Seeded admin: tugberkkalay@gmail.com (role=admin, no password – Emergent Google OAuth). For backend testing used direct Mongo-inserted session tokens per /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: In test_database: created 1 admin session (session_token=test_admin_session_1786447025489 for seeded admin user_5ef45c18783c) and 1 employee user (user_test_emp_1786447025500, test.employee.1786447025500@example.com) with session_token=test_emp_session_1786447025500. Backend tests also created TEST_Training with checkpoint at t=10 and quiz (2 MC + 1 free_text). Assignments and progress rows exist and are consumed by reports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sessions are stored in DB and remain valid for 7 days. To re-run backend tests: cd /app && EDUFLOW_BASE_URL=<url> ADMIN_TOKEN=test_admin_session_1786447025489 EMP_TOKEN=test_emp_session_1786447025500 EMP_UID=user_test_emp_1786447025500 python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml (MUST use -n 0 because pytest.ini enables xdist which breaks shared _state across workers). Note the seeded employee already has completed assignments — for a clean retest either create a new employee/session or delete assignments+progress for EMP_UID.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only observation: pytest xdist loadscope across classes broke shared _state dict during initial run; solved by running with -n 0 (serial). This is a test-harness concern, not a product bug.
